description: AI-generated styled campaign photography based on actual original cookie assortment; not photographs of fulfilled orders.

scenes.title: Celebration assortment
scenes.scene: A cream oval ceramic serving platter at a family celebration, photographed close enough for every cookie's texture to be visible. Arrange a small assortment of the actual reference shapes: powdered scalloped alfajores, rose-imprinted golden flower cookies, sugar-dusted pointed star cookies and chocolate-topped round alfajores. Several natural overlaps, varied orientations, thoughtful but unforced composition. The entire plate is visible and the cookies fill most of the frame.
scenes.env: Warm ivory tablecloth, small folded crimson-and-cream Peruvian woven textile at the far edge, hand-glazed cream platter, a few crumbs. No distracting patterned tray.
scenes.camera: 50mm lens at f/5.6, high three-quarter angle, medium depth of field keeping all key shapes and fillings sharp.

scenes.title: Chocolate alfajores
scenes.scene: An intimate close-up of the chocolate-topped alfajores from the FIRST reference: round shortbread sandwich cookies with a visible caramel filling, chocolate coating only on the top face with the same subtle hand-spread swirl marks. Four cookies on a small cream ceramic plate; two resting slightly against one another, the rest flat. Keep the shortbread sides and real dulce de leche visible. Chocolate has a gentle natural satin finish, not a mirror glaze.
scenes.env: Matte cream ceramic plate on light honey wood, muted burgundy linen napkin in one corner, one small ivory cup of black coffee softly out of focus behind. A few tiny biscuit crumbs.
scenes.camera: 85mm lens at f/4.5, near cookie-level three-quarter view, precise focus on the foreground chocolate texture, scalloped edge and filling.

scenes.title: Flowers and stars
scenes.scene: A small gathering of the actual rose-imprinted flower shortbread and pointed star/snowflake cookies from the FIRST reference, together with two familiar powdered scalloped alfajores. The rose flowers are simple flat golden shortbread with crisp recessed petal outlines, not sculptural frosting roses. The star shapes closely match the reference's cutout geometry, some lightly powdered and some golden. Arrange naturally on an ivory ceramic dessert plate, product occupies most of frame, the flower impressions and fine baked texture fully readable.
scenes.env: Natural ivory linen, cream ceramic dessert plate with a thin red rim, narrow crimson-and-cream Peruvian woven cloth visible along one corner, a few realistic crumbs. Morning sunlight softened through a window.
scenes.camera: 50mm lens at f/6.3, close high three-quarter angle, deep enough focus for flower imprints and star edges to be crisp.

params.prompt:
[SCENE]
A cream oval ceramic serving platter at a family celebration, photographed close enough for every cookie's texture to be visible. Arrange a small assortment of the actual reference shapes: powdered scalloped alfajores, rose-imprinted golden flower cookies, sugar-dusted pointed star cookies and chocolate-topped round alfajores. Several natural overlaps, varied orientations, thoughtful but unforced composition. The entire plate is visible and the cookies fill most of the frame.
[PRODUCT PLACEMENT]
The cookies are the visual hero, with appetizing readable details and believable scale.
[ENVIRONMENT DETAILS]
Warm ivory tablecloth, small folded crimson-and-cream Peruvian woven textile at the far edge, hand-glazed cream platter, a few crumbs. No distracting patterned tray.
[LENS & CAMERA]
50mm lens at f/5.6, high three-quarter angle, medium depth of field keeping all key shapes and fillings sharp.
[PRODUCT IDENTITY]
The FIRST reference is the bakery's actual product assortment and must control cookie shapes and finishes. Reproduce its scalloped round powdered alfajores with caramel manjar blanco filling; its flat rose-imprinted flower shortbread cookies with crisp recessed petal outlines; its small pointed star/snowflake cutouts; and its round sandwich cookies topped with hand-spread chocolate. Preserve pale golden crumbly shortbread, natural small baked cracks, irregular powdered sugar and modest handmade proportions. The SECOND reference is only for the warm lighting, ceramic-and-linen styling and photographic quality. Do not turn these into macarons, thick American cookies or cakes. Preserve the specific cookie types requested for this shot.
[HUMAN ELEMENT]
No people or hands; a few authentic crumbs suggest a real home bakery.
[LIGHTING]
Large window at camera-left, 5000K neutral daylight gently warmed by cream surroundings. Soft directional light, gentle shadow falloff, grounded contact shadows, visible natural texture, no clipped sugar highlights.
[ATMOSPHERE]
Appetizing and quietly celebratory, warm home-bakery intimacy with natural imperfections.
[COLOR PALETTE]
Ivory, cream, caramel and deep crimson #a31f1f. Restrained saturation and natural contrast.
[STYLE REFERENCE]
Warm food storytelling, bright tactile food detail, natural handmade still-life photography and subtle editorial retouching.
[QUALITY MARKERS]
Tack-sharp commercial photography, editorial commercial standard, ultra-realistic textures and materials, professional retouching standard, no AI artifacts.
[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image, no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering, no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects, no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look, no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash, no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions, no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures, no AI sheen on hair or skin, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look, no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones that look out of place. No stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look, no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments, no perfect symmetry where natural asymmetry should be, no clipart elements, no flat illustration mixed with photo, no obviously composited backgrounds. No coconut, icing flowers, piped frosting, rainbow sprinkles, floating cookies or dripping chocolate.
resolution: 2k
